t: Obtaining Child Assent and Parental Consent :: Institutional Review Board :: Swarthmore College
s: September 26, 2018 - Federal law defines "children" as persons who have not attained the legal age for consent to treatments or procedures involved in the research, under the applicable law of the jurisdiction in which the research will be conducted. t: Understanding Parental Consent – Full Circle Health
s: The Parents’ Rights in Medical Decision-Making Act (the “Act”), I.C. § 32-1015, became law on July 1st, 2024. The Act states: “Except as otherwise provided by court order, an individual shall not furnish a health care service or solicit to furnish a health care service to a minor child without obtaining the prior consent of the minor child’s parent.”
